searchText: You don't get to pick the number. could you explain what you mean EIP numbers are assigned at the time the EIP is created. Essentially, the number is random (or should be treated as such). If you create an EIP for a new standard, it may be EIP-4573 or something. If it is an ERC (a subset of EIPs) then it will also be ERC-4573. May i ask some question? If it is related to EIP authoring, then https://discord.gg/Rdcg5zGh is a better place to ask.
